title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
ii.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
iii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iv.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
v.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
colophon: drift and pull; a field that never settles the same way twice.
